lines.text: Sam's dad always said hiking wasn't for him.
Too long, too steep, too cold.
Here's the trick. Sam stopped asking and gave him a coupon instead:
one short hike, hot chocolate after, Sam drives.
He picked an easy two-mile loop, checked the weather, and set a turnaround time.
Halfway round, his dad stopped to look at the lake and said,
Save this gift idea for your family.
